subject: Physics
concept: Every measured value needs a unit and an uncertainty. Dimensions check whether an equation can be right. They do not prove it is right.
q: A student writes Z = A^2 B^(1/3) / (C^3 D^2). The maximum fractional error is
easy: Powers become multipliers. A negative power still adds, because the error is the magnitude of the relative change.

subject: Physics
concept: Average velocity is displacement over time. Instantaneous velocity is the slope of x-t. If acceleration depends on velocity, you cannot use v = u + at.
q: Acceleration is given as a function of velocity, not time. The first step is
options: Write a = v dv/dx or a = dv/dt and separate variables
Read the slope of a v-t graph that was not given
easy: If a is not constant, the constant-acceleration formulas are out.

subject: Physics
concept: A projectile on level ground has constant horizontal velocity and vertical acceleration g downward. On an incline, take axes along and perpendicular to the incline.
q: A boat must go straight across a river. Its speed in still water is less than the current. What is true?
options: It cannot land directly opposite; some drift remains
It can, by pointing straight across
It can, by pointing upstream at any angle
easy: The cross-stream component must cancel the current. If boat speed is smaller than the current, that component cannot be large enough.

subject: Physics
concept: Newton's second law is about net force. In a string-pulley constraint, the accelerations are linked by the string length. On an accelerating frame, a pseudo force is added only if you work in that frame.
q: Two blocks share a friction surface and the lower one is accelerated. They move together only if
options: The required friction is not larger than the maximum static friction
The upper block has no weight
easy: Together means one acceleration. Friction supplies that acceleration, up to μN.

subject: Physics
concept: Work is force along displacement. For a variable force, add F dx. A conservative force has a potential, and F = -dU/dx.
q: On a U-x curve, a stable equilibrium is where
easy: Force is minus the slope. A minimum has restoring force on both sides.

subject: Physics
concept: Torque is r cross F. About a fixed axis, torque equals I alpha. Pure rolling on a fixed surface means the contact point is at rest, so v = R omega.
q: On a surface at rest, the no-slip condition is
easy: The contact point is instantaneously at rest. That is v = R omega, not a stopped body.

subject: Physics
concept: Outside a spherical mass, the field is like a point mass at the centre. Inside a uniform solid sphere, the field is proportional to r.
q: A tunnel through a uniform Earth. The field inside is
options: Proportional to distance from the centre
The same as on the surface
easy: Only the mass within radius r pulls. That mass grows as r^3, so the field grows as r.

subject: Physics
concept: Bernoulli compares pressure, speed and height along a streamline for steady, incompressible, non-viscous flow. Torricelli's speed for a small hole is sqrt(2gh) when the top is open.
q: A tank has a hole at depth h below the free surface. The efflux speed is
easy: Compare the top and the hole. The height drop becomes speed.

subject: Physics
concept: The first law is ΔU = Q + W, with the sign convention fixed. For an ideal gas, internal energy depends only on temperature.
q: In a free expansion of an ideal gas into vacuum
options: Work is done on the gas
easy: No heat, no external pressure to push against, so U and T stay the same.

subject: Physics
concept: SHM means acceleration is proportional to minus displacement. Energy moves between kinetic and potential. The period of a spring-mass system is 2π sqrt(m/k).
q: Two springs of constant k are in series. The effective k is
easy: Series springs share the force and add extensions, so the combination is softer.

subject: Physics
concept: A travelling wave keeps its shape and moves at speed v. A standing wave is two waves of the same frequency in opposite directions. A string fixed at both ends has nodes at the ends.
q: Beats come from
easy: The beat frequency is the difference of the two frequencies.

subject: Physics
concept: Coulomb's law is for point charges. For a continuous distribution, add the contributions. Gauss's law is useful when the symmetry makes the field constant on a surface.
q: Gauss's law is the fast tool for
options: A long straight wire, an infinite sheet, or a sphere
A dipole at a random point
easy: You need a surface on which E is constant or zero.

subject: Physics
concept: Potential is work per charge by the external agent, slowly. Capacitors in series share charge. In parallel they share voltage.
q: A battery stays connected while a dielectric is inserted. What rises?
easy: Voltage is fixed by the battery. Capacitance rises, so charge and energy rise.

subject: Physics
concept: Current is charge per time. Kirchhoff's junction rule is charge conservation. The loop rule is energy conservation.
q: Maximum power to a load from a cell of emf E and internal resistance r happens when
easy: P = I^2 R with I = E/(R+r). The maximum is at R = r.

subject: Physics
concept: A charge in a uniform B field moves in a circle if v is perpendicular to B, and in a helix if it has a component along B.
q: The radius of the circular part is
easy: Magnetic force supplies the centripetal force.

subject: Physics
concept: Faraday: induced emf equals minus the rate of change of flux. Lenz says the induced current opposes the change that caused it.
q: A rod slides on rails in a uniform B field. The motional emf is
easy: Flux changes because the area of the loop changes.

subject: Physics
concept: The thin-lens formula is 1/v - 1/u = 1/f. A ray through the optical centre goes straight. A ray parallel to the axis passes through the focus.
q: An object is at the focus of a convex lens. The image is
easy: Rays leaving the focus come out parallel.

subject: Physics
concept: In Young's experiment, fringe width is β = λD/d. A thin sheet in one path shifts the central fringe toward that slit.
q: If the slit separation d increases, the fringe width
easy: β is inversely proportional to d.

subject: Physics
concept: Einstein: K_max = hν - φ. Below the threshold frequency, no electrons leave, however bright the light.
q: Stopping potential depends on
options: The colour of the metal holder
easy: Intensity changes the number of electrons, not the energy of each.

subject: Physics
concept: Bohr: angular momentum is n h / 2π. The photon energy is the difference of the two levels.
q: A hydrogen atom drops from n = 3 to n = 2. The photon energy is
easy: Emission energy is the higher level minus the lower level.

subject: Physics
concept: Binding energy per nucleon peaks near iron. Fusion is favoured for light nuclei, fission for heavy ones.
q: Radioactivity is not in the current CBSE board list, but it remains in JEE. N = N0 e^(-λt) means
options: The number falls by the same fraction in every half-life
It falls by a fixed number each second
λ is the number of atoms
easy: Half-life is the time for N to halve, whatever N is.

subject: Physics
concept: A p-n junction conducts easily in forward bias and poorly in reverse bias. Zener and logic gates are thin on the current board list and common in JEE Main.
q: In forward bias, the p side is
options: At higher potential than the n side
easy: Forward bias lowers the barrier.

subject: Chemistry
concept: The mole is the counting unit. A limiting reagent is the one that runs out first. Concentration can be written as molarity, molality or mole fraction.
q: Molarity changes with temperature because
options: The volume of the solution changes
easy: Moles stay. Volume expands, so molarity falls.

subject: Chemistry
concept: Bohr explains the hydrogen spectrum. Four quantum numbers label an electron. The magnetic moment of an ion is sqrt(n(n+2)) Bohr magnetons for n unpaired electrons.
q: A hydrogen line in the Balmer series ends at
easy: Balmer ends at n = 2. Lyman ends at n = 1.

subject: Chemistry
concept: VSEPR counts electron pairs and places them as far apart as possible. A lone pair takes more room than a bond pair.
q: Water is bent because
easy: Four pairs, two of them lone, give a bent shape.

subject: Chemistry
concept: ΔH is the heat at constant pressure. Hess's law says the enthalpy change depends on start and end, not the path.
q: For an ideal gas in an isothermal expansion
easy: U for an ideal gas depends only on T. T is fixed, so ΔU is zero.

subject: Chemistry
concept: K is constant at a given temperature. A buffer resists pH change. The Henderson relation is pH = pKa + log([salt]/[acid]) for a weak acid and its salt.
q: Adding a common ion to a weak acid
easy: The extra ion pushes the equilibrium back.

subject: Chemistry
concept: Inductive, resonance and hyperconjugation decide charge stability. A more stable carbocation is easier to form.
q: The most stable of these carbocations is usually
easy: Alkyl groups stabilise the positive carbon.

subject: Chemistry
concept: Alkenes add HX by Markovnikov unless peroxide is present for HBr. Ozonolysis cuts the double bond and tells you where it was.
q: Peroxide affects the addition of
easy: Only HBr has a useful peroxide path.

subject: Chemistry
concept: Oxidation is written on the left, reduction on the right. At 298 K, E = E° - (0.059/n) log Q. n is the electrons in the balanced cell reaction.
q: Zn|Zn2+(0.01 M)||Cu2+(1 M)|Cu, E° = 1.10 V. What is E at 298 K?

subject: Chemistry
concept: Order is experimental. For a first-order reaction, half-life is independent of concentration. The Arrhenius equation links k to temperature.
q: A first-order half-life is 10 min. After 20 min the reactant is
easy: Two half-lives leave one quarter.

subject: Chemistry
concept: The coordination number is the number of ligand donor atoms attached to the metal. Crystal-field splitting decides high-spin or low-spin.
q: In an octahedral complex, a strong-field ligand
options: Pairs electrons and gives low spin
easy: A large split makes pairing cheaper than occupying the higher set.

subject: Chemistry
concept: A carbonyl carbon is attacked by a nucleophile. An aldol needs an alpha hydrogen on the enolate partner.
q: A carbonyl with no alpha hydrogen cannot
options: Form an enolate for an aldol
easy: No alpha hydrogen means no enolate.

subject: Chemistry
concept: Glucose is an aldohexose. A reducing sugar has a free hemiacetal. Sucrose does not.
q: Sucrose is non-reducing because
options: Both anomeric carbons are tied in the glycosidic bond
easy: The anomeric carbons are locked.

subject: Mathematics
concept: The unit circle fixes the sign of each ratio. A general solution includes the period, not one angle only.
q: sin x = 1/2. A complete solution needs
options: The principal angles plus the period
easy: The wave repeats. One angle is not the full solution.

subject: Mathematics
concept: A complex number is a point in the Argand plane. Multiplication by i rotates by 90°. The modulus is the distance from the origin.
q: The modulus of 3 + 4i is

subject: Mathematics
concept: A permutation is an arrangement. A combination is a selection. Order matters only in the first.
q: The number of ways to choose 2 students from 5 is
easy: 5C2 = 10. Order is not counted.

subject: Mathematics
concept: An AP has a constant difference. A GP has a constant ratio. The AM-GM inequality says the arithmetic mean is at least the geometric mean.
q: For positive numbers, AM - GM is
easy: Equality holds when the numbers are equal.

subject: Mathematics
concept: The slope is rise over run. The distance from a point to a line is the perpendicular distance, not the slanted one.
q: Two lines are parallel when
easy: Same slope means same direction.

subject: Mathematics
concept: A parabola is the set of points equidistant from a focus and a directrix. A tangent touches at one point.
q: For y^2 = 4ax, the focus is
easy: The focus is a units from the vertex along the axis.

subject: Mathematics
concept: A limit is the value approached, not the value plugged in when the expression is undefined. The derivative is the slope of the tangent.
q: lim x→0 sin x / x equals
easy: This is a standard limit. The plug-in 0/0 is not the answer.

subject: Mathematics
concept: Matrix multiplication is row by column. It is not commutative. A matrix times its inverse is the identity, when the inverse exists.
q: AB = BA is
options: True only if A is zero
easy: Order of multiplication matters.

subject: Mathematics
concept: A zero determinant means the rows are dependent and the matrix has no inverse. Cramer's rule needs a non-zero determinant.
q: If det A = 0, the system AX = B
easy: No inverse means not a unique solution. It may have none or infinitely many.

subject: Mathematics
concept: Continuity means the limit equals the value. Differentiability needs the left and right derivatives to match.
q: A corner, such as |x| at 0, is
easy: The graph is joined, but the slope jumps.

subject: Mathematics
concept: f' > 0 means increasing. A local maximum on an open interval has f' = 0 and a change from rising to falling.
q: If f'(x) > 0 on an interval, f is
easy: Positive slope means the value rises as x rises.

subject: Mathematics
concept: An indefinite integral is a family of antiderivatives. A definite integral is a number. King's property swaps x with a+b-x.
q: The derivative of an indefinite integral of f is
options: f, plus the constant disappears on differentiation
easy: Integration and differentiation undo each other.

subject: Mathematics
concept: The order is the highest derivative. A first-order linear equation uses an integrating factor e to the integral of P.
q: dy/dx + P y = Q is solved by
easy: The factor makes the left side a derivative of a product.

subject: Mathematics
concept: The dot product is a scalar. The cross product is a vector perpendicular to both. The scalar triple product is the volume of the parallelepiped.
q: a · b = 0 means
options: The vectors are perpendicular, if neither is zero
easy: Zero dot product means a right angle.

subject: Mathematics
concept: A line in space needs a point and a direction. Two skew lines do not meet and are not parallel. Their shortest distance is along the common perpendicular.
q: Skew lines
options: Do not intersect and are not parallel
easy: If they were in one plane and did not meet, they would be parallel.

subject: Mathematics
concept: Conditional probability is the chance given that something already happened. Bayes updates a prior with evidence.
q: P(A|B) is
options: P(A and B) / P(B), if P(B) is not zero
easy: Condition on B, so divide by the chance of B.
